Bloodlines
Pre-Release Weekend
December 1 and 2, 2001

================

In conjunction with the V:EKN Princes, White Wolf is
pleased to host a worldwide pre-release weekend for
the Bloodlines expansion on December 1st and 2nd.
These events will be players' first opportunity to
play with the new cards, which won't be officially
released until December 3rd. To find out more
information about the Pre-Release party nearest you
(including date, time, cost, and materials you may
need to bring), contact the prince or the store
listed for that event below.
